mapper.sql: m.id, m.code, m.name, m.status, m.timezone, m.settlement_currency, m.create_time, m.update_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM scx_media m INNER JOIN scx_user_subject_scope scope ON scope.subject_id = m.id AND scope.subject_type = 'MEDIA' AND scope.user_id = #{userId} WHERE m.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY m.name ASC
